name: Class Diagram
description: Describes the static structure of a system via classes, attributes, methods, and relationships.

name: Object Diagram
description: Describes specific class instances and their attribute values at a point in runtime.

name: Component Diagram
description: Describes independent software components, interfaces, and their dependencies.

name: Deployment Diagram
description: Describes artifacts deployed to physical nodes and communication paths between them.

name: Package Diagram
description: Describes package/module organization and dependencies between them.

name: Composite Structure Diagram
description: Describes the internal runtime structure of a classifier, including parts, ports, and connectors.

name: Profile Diagram
description: Extends UML with stereotypes, tagged values, and constraints for a specific domain.

name: Use Case Diagram
description: Describes external actors and the functional goals they want to achieve with the system.
shortDescription: Actor, use case, system boundary, include/extend

name: Activity Diagram
description: Describes workflows, algorithms, or business processes with actions, decisions, and fork/join.

name: State Machine Diagram
description: Describes an object's lifecycle states including states, events, guards, and transitions.

name: Sequence Diagram
description: Describes the chronological order of interactions between actors, objects, services, or databases.

name: Communication Diagram
description: Describes participating objects, links between them, and numbered messages.

name: Interaction Overview Diagram
description: Describes the high-level coordination flow between multiple sub-sequence diagrams.
shortDescription: Interaction occurrence, control flow, decision, fork/join

name: Timing Diagram
description: Describes state or value changes of a lifeline over a time axis.

name: C4 Context Diagram
description: Level 1: Overview of the system, users, and external systems.
shortDescription: L1: Person, Software System, External System

name: C4 Container Diagram
description: Level 2: Describes technology containers (Web App, API, DB, Queue).

name: C4 Component Diagram
description: Level 3: Decomposes a container's internal structure into components.

name: C4 Code Diagram
description: Level 4: Describes class entity details (equivalent to UML Class Diagram).
shortDescription: L4: Class, entity, attribute, method, relationship

name: Use Case — E-Commerce System
description: Identifies actors and main functions of an e-commerce system.
shortDescription: Actor, use cases, system boundary for e-commerce system

name: Class Diagram — Domain Model E-Commerce
description: Designs entities, attributes, methods, and relationships between classes in a sales domain.
shortDescription: Entity, ORM, relationships for e-commerce system

name: Sequence — OAuth2 Login Flow
description: Describes interaction order between User, Frontend, Auth Server, and Database for OAuth2.
shortDescription: Lifeline, message, alt fragment for OAuth2 login

name: Activity — Order Approval Process
description: Describes order processing and approval workflow across multiple departments with swimlanes.
shortDescription: Workflow, decision, swimlane for order approval process

name: Deployment — Kubernetes System
description: Describes artifacts, nodes, containers, and communication paths on Kubernetes.
shortDescription: Node, artifact, pod, service mesh for cloud infrastructure

name: C4 Context — E-Commerce System
description: Overview of an e-commerce system, its users, and external systems.
shortDescription: L1: Context diagram for e-commerce system

name: C4 Container — Backend Architecture
description: Containers (Web App, API, Database, Message Queue) in the backend.
shortDescription: L2: Container diagram for backend e-commerce

name: C4 Component — Order Service
description: Decomposes the internal structure of Order Service: Controller, Service, Repository.

name: C4 Code — Class Entities
description: Details of class entities in the E-Commerce domain model.
shortDescription: L4: Code diagram — class entity details
